LanguageData.MST.harmsHealthComment: Does this damage reduce health? If off, the damage does not reduce health (e.g. pure stun/EMP) but may still have other effects.
LanguageData.MST.makesBloodComment: Whether the damage produces blood filth at the wound. If off, no blood stains appear.
LanguageData.MST.isRangedComment: Whether the game treats this as ranged damage. Affects shooting, hit chance, melee dodging, etc.
LanguageData.MST.isExplosiveComment: Whether the damage is dealt as an explosion. When on, the explosion detail fields below apply to targets in the blast area.
LanguageData.MST.executionComment: Execution damage: instantly executes the target on hit (ignores remaining health). Used for execution/finisher mechanics.
LanguageData.MST.causeStunComment: Whether this damage stuns the target. When on, targets briefly lose the ability to act; duration is set by the stun fields below.
LanguageData.MST.ignoreShieldsComment: Whether this damage ignores shields (belt shields, energy shields) and hits the body directly.
LanguageData.MST.minDamageToFragmentComment: Damage at or above this value destroys a body part into fragments.
LanguageData.MST.overkillPctToDestroyPartComment: If overkill damage reaches this fraction of a part's max HP, the part is destroyed (decimal range 0~1).
LanguageData.MST.bluntInnerHitChanceComment: Chance for blunt damage to bypass outer layers and directly hit internal organs.
LanguageData.MST.bluntInnerHitDamageFractionToConvert: Range of blunt damage converted into internal damage.
LanguageData.MST.bluntInnerHitDamageFractionToAddComm: Range of extra damage added when blunt hits internal organs.
LanguageData.MST.bluntStunDurationComment: Stun duration (seconds) caused by blunt damage.
LanguageData.MST.stabChanceOfForcedInternalComment: Chance for a stab hit to force a hit on internal organs.
LanguageData.MST.cutCleaveBonusComment: Extra bonus for cut damage triggering cleave (damaging nearby targets).
LanguageData.MST.cutExtraTargetsCurveComment: Curve determining extra cleave targets based on cut damage dealt.
LanguageData.MST.scratchSplitPercentageComment: Fraction of scratch damage split into multiple smaller hits.
LanguageData.MST.stunAdaptationTicksComment: Adaptation time (ticks) before the same target can be stunned again; repeated stuns are weakened.
LanguageData.MST.constantStunDurationTicksComment: Fixed stun duration (ticks). Leave empty to compute stun from damage dealt.
LanguageData.MST.expolosionPropagationSpeedComment: How fast the explosion propagates through the grid.
LanguageData.MST.explosionInteriorCellCountMultiplier: Multiplier for interior explosion cells near the center.
LanguageData.MST.explosionInteriorCellDistanceMultipl: Distance multiplier for interior explosion cells.
LanguageData.MST.scaleDamageToBuildingsBasedOnFlammab: Whether building damage scales with the building's flammability.
LanguageData.MST.harmAllLayersUntilOutsideComment: Whether the damage penetrates all clothing layers until it reaches parts outside the outermost layer.
LanguageData.MST.explosionAffectOutsidePartsOnlyComme: Whether the explosion only affects outermost body parts.
LanguageData.MST.igniteChanceByTargetFlammabilityComm: Only applies to fire damage (DamageWorker_Flame): chance to ignite based on target flammability.
LanguageData.MST.igniteCellChanceComment: Only applies to fire damage (DamageWorker_Flame): per-cell ignite chance.
